title: Four Squares Apart
setup: Black's rook on e6 stands on a light diagonal that ends on its own king, tucked away in the corner on c8.
hint: Find the light diagonal that runs from your side of the board through the rook to the black king.
explanation:
## The Idea

The squares g4, f5, e6, d7 and c8 form one diagonal. {{Bg4}} occupies its near end, so the rook on **e6** is pinned to the king on **c8** and attacked at the same time. Nothing guards the rook, and it cannot move.
